rules.logic: CAST(prv_id AS INTEGER) AS provider_id -- direct passthrough, no value transformation needed; ensure referential integrity against prv_tbl.prv_id
rules.null_handling: Preserve NULL as NULL; NULL likely indicates the encounter had no assigned/known provider at time of recording (e.g., self-service, unassigned, or data entry gap). Do not default to 0 or a sentinel value -- keep as NULL to avoid falsely implying a valid provider link. Flag rows with NULL prv_id for review if downstream reporting requires a provider on every encounter.
edge_cases: 10% null rate suggests a systematic reason (e.g., certain encounter types like self-check-in or automated billing may not require a provider) rather than random missingness -- worth investigating enc_typ_cd correlation
Cardinality of 40 distinct providers should be cross-checked against total row count in prv_tbl to ensure no orphaned FK values exist
Integer type with FK relationship implies simple surrogate key join; no transformation of value itself expected
